summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 14, 2026, announcing a secondary public offering of 9,000,000 Class A common shares by selling shareholder OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l., an Oaktree-managed vehicle. The selling shareholder beneficially owned approximately 20% of TORM's Class A shares before the offering and is granting the underwriter a 30-day option for up to 1,350,000 additional shares. TORM is not selling shares and will receive no proceeds. J.P. Morgan is sole underwriter. This is a routine shelf-registered secondary offering, not a special situation. Key watch items include pricing and remaining Oaktree overhang.
